sign_off.notes: I found no bugs and filed no reports. Covered: card browser (cards/notes toggle, per-mode columns, truncate option persistence, tag filter, deck filter, counts), add and edit note (deck chooser order with nested decks, adding a note, editing a back field and a tag, rotation), and the deck list (expand/collapse arrows over 2 and 3 nesting levels, state kept after leaving and returning, counts after adding a note). The one oddity: newly created parent decks start collapsed. The arrows and the visible children agree with each other, so I did not report it. I did not test study/review or deck rename/delete. I added a few test notes and decks (gato, Spanish::Verbs, French::Food, Spanish::Verbs::Irregular) and did not remove them.
